ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

FixtureEntry.description:
One fixture entry: a recorded upstream exchange and the facade response
the pack must produce for it.

expectedFacadeResponse.description: The facade response the replay expects.

upstreamResponse.description: The upstream reply the route works from.

FixtureProvenance.description:
Where a fixture's recording came from
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 13.3): captured from a live
system, or documented as an authored reconstruction.

oneOf.description: Recorded from the named live system.

reference.description: Where the recording came from, for review.

oneOf.description: Authored from the source system's documented behavior.

reference.description: The documentation the reconstruction follows, for review.

HttpMethod.description:
An HTTP method a facade operation or an upstream send may declare. The
method decides send safety: `GET` is safe, the write methods are not
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 8.7 and 9).

Intercept.description:
One declared intercept. Fixture replay intercepts `http` and `graphql`
sends and the token endpoint of an OAuth2 kind; nothing else is
interceptable.

oneOf.description: Intercept every send to the named endpoint.

endpoint.description: The pack endpoint id whose sends replay from the fixtures.

oneOf.description:
Intercept the token requests of the named endpoint's OAuth2 kind
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.2).

endpoint.description:
The pack endpoint whose token requests replay from the
fixtures.

RecordedRequest.description: One recorded upstream request the fixture replay matches against.

endpoint.description: The endpoint the request goes to.

path.description: The request path, with any template segments already filled.

status.description: The status the upstream answered with.

description: The fixture suite artifact (`AdapterFixture`), authored per pack.

intercepts.description:
The sends this suite intercepts, by endpoint id and token endpoint.
A route never declares its own test intercepts.

upstreamVersion.description: The upstream version the recording reflects.
